zh-CN.title: 聊天快捷操作
items: 快捷按钮增高并从左排列，不再撑满整行
锁定、复制、搜索固定为圆角正方形，日历和状态随空间展开信息

en.title: Chat quick actions
items: Taller quick actions align from the left without stretching across the row
Lock, copy and search stay rounded squares; calendar and presence adapt their information to the available width
